category-def.name: raaml.picto.studio
category-def.label: RAAML Picto Studio
category-def.description: RAAML Picto Studio is a model-driven safety analysis workbench built on Eclipse Epsilon and Picto. It provides live, interactive HTML visualizations for ISO 26262 safety analyses - including FMEA, FTA, HARA, STPA, GSN, HAZOP and Requirements - using the RAAML (Risk Analysis and Assessment Modelling Language) metamodel.
